description_en: Performs a primary/secondary switchover (switches node roles). This operation can be used for disaster recovery drills and nearest access for applications in multi-zone deployment scenarios
description_zh: 执行主备切换（即切换节点角色），可应用于容灾演练、多可用区场景下的应用就近连接等需求
name: SwitchInstanceHA

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html to query the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data shard node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473782.html to obtain the CustinsId parameter. Separate multiple data shard node IDs with commas (,). To specify all nodes, enter `all`.
This parameter is available and required only when the instance uses the cluster or read/write splitting architecture
parameters.help_zh:
数据分片节点ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473782.html获取CustinsId参数，多个数据分片节点ID之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔，如需指定所有节点请输入0。
当实例为集群或读写分离架构时，本参数才可用，且必填
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution time. Valid values:
0: immediately. This is the default value.
1: during the maintenance window.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html to modify the maintenance window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
执行时间，取值：
0：立即执行，默认值。
1：在可维护时间段执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en:
The switchover mode. Valid values:
ReliabilityPriority (default): Reliability is prioritized. The primary/secondary switchover is performed only when primary/secondary synchronization has no latency, which prevents data loss. In scenarios with heavy write workloads and persistent synchronization latency, this mode may cause the primary/secondary switchover to fail.
AvailablePriority: Availability is prioritized. The primary/secondary switchover is performed immediately regardless of primary/secondary latency, which may cause minor data loss.

Evaluate your business requirements for data integrity and service availability before selecting a switchover mode
parameters.help_zh:
切换模式，取值：
ReliabilityPriority (默认值)：可靠性优先，确保主备同步无延迟时才执行主备切换，不会丢失数据。该模式在写入量较大且持续存在同步延迟的场景下，可能会造成主备切换失败。
AvailablePriority：可用性优先，不考虑主备延迟，立即执行主备切换，可能会丢失少量数据。


您需要根据业务场景对数据、服务等方面的需求进行衡量，然后选取切换模式
parameters.name: switch_type

parameters.help_en: The node ID of the original MASTER node in the shard
parameters.help_zh: 分片原 MASTER 节点的节点 ID
parameters.name: source_node_id

parameters.help_en: The node ID of the target MASTER node after the switchover
parameters.help_zh: 切换后目标 MASTER 节点的节点 ID
parameters.name: target_node_id

parameters.help_en: The shard name of the instance
parameters.name: target_shard_name
